title: Acts Interpretation Act 1931
why: The Tasmanian Act that supplies the default rules for reading Tasmanian Acts and the regulations made under them: definitions of common terms, commencement and expiry, computation of time, purposive interpretation, use of extrinsic material, delegation, and the like.

text.conversion: plain text converted by Legalese Commons from the site's whole-document HTML view (/view/whole/html/inforce/current/<id>) with a Python html.parser script (tas_convert.py, written for this deposit to the method of the earlier Tasmanian deposit of the Civil Liability Act 2002): only the document body (the element with id fragview) is read; headings, section numbers and the Schedule heading and clause numbers kept; one paragraph per line with blank lines between; hyperlinks removed (link text kept); the site's editorial history notes (spans of class view-history-note) removed; the stray space the site's markup leaves between a link or a word and following punctuation removed; rows of dots that the site shows for repealed or omitted provisions kept as dots; a notice block prepended. No table, image or formula occurs in this Act. The script stops with an error on any tag, class or image it does not know.
